title: Ruby Horizon Lib
description: Base lib for Ruby Horizon plugins
body:
# Ruby Horizon Lib

## 📖 What is this?
This is a library of commonly used components in our Minecraft plugins. Some of our plugins will not work without this library.

## 📖 Installation on the server
Put plugin into your plugins folder and enjoy.

## 📖 Can I use this library for my projects?
Yes, you can! Our library is distributed under the MIT license. All you need to do is to indicate the original author (Ruby Horizon Team).

## 📖 For developers

Check out the readme on [github repository](https://github.com/RubyHorizon/RubyHorizonLib) for more information.
